dialogue.origin: こんにちは。本日はロールプレイをよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you in advance for today’s role-play.

dialogue.origin: こんにちはこちらこそ宜しくお願いいたします(^^)
dialogue.content: Hello, thank you as well. (^^)

dialogue.origin: 時間になりましたら開始させていただきます
dialogue.content: We will begin when it's time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。最初に年齢と性別をおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm a counselor. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 16歳　女です
dialogue.content: I’m 16, female.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談にきてくださりありがとうございます。本日のご相談はどのような事ですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 友達のことです
dialogue.content: It's about my friends.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。詳しく聞かせてください
dialogue.content: I see. Please tell me more.

dialogue.origin: こちらではどのようなお話をしていただいても大丈夫ですのでご安心くださいね
dialogue.content: Please rest assured that you can talk about anything here, so feel at ease.

dialogue.origin: 1年のときから仲良しの５人のグループでいるんですけどその中の1人を怒らせちゃって無視されるようになっちゃいました
dialogue.content: I've been in a group of five close friends since our first year, but I angered one of them, and now they're ignoring me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは悲しいですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be sad.

dialogue.origin: はいもう学校行きたくないです
dialogue.content: Yes, I don’t even want to go to school anymore.

dialogue.origin: 辛いですねそう思ってしまうのも無理はないですね…
dialogue.content: That’s tough. It’s understandable that you feel that way…

dialogue.origin: でも行かないわけにも行かないしどうしたらいいですか
dialogue.content: But I can’t just not go. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: ええ、本日はどうしたらいいか一緒に考えていけたらと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, today I hope we can think together about what to do.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 一人を怒らせて５人全員から無視されるようになってしまったのですか？
dialogue.content: Did angering one person lead to the whole group of five ignoring you?

dialogue.origin: はい少しは話してくれる子もいるけど無視してって言われてるらしくて
dialogue.content: Yes, some of them still talk to me a little, but apparently they've been told to ignore me.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。急にグループみんなから無視されてしまうととても辛いですね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be very painful to suddenly be ignored by your whole group.

dialogue.origin: ５人だけじゃなくてクラスの子みんなに言ってるみたいで他のグループの子は少しは話してくれるけど、違うグループだからあんまり意味ないし
dialogue.content: It seems she told not just our group of five, but everyone in the class. Kids from other groups talk to me a little, but it doesn't really mean much since they're not in my group.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…クラスみんなからそのような空気を作られてしまったらいづらくなってしまうよね…
dialogue.content: I see… When that kind of atmosphere is created by the whole class, it must feel hard to be there…

dialogue.origin: いつ頃から無視されるようになったのかな？
dialogue.content: When did they start ignoring you?

dialogue.origin: 1週間くらい前です
dialogue.content: About a week ago.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。１週間とても辛かったね。
dialogue.content: I see. This past week must have been very tough for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もう学校行けない
dialogue.content: I can't go to school anymore.

dialogue.origin: でも、この１週間は耐えていたんだね。すごいね
dialogue.content: But you've endured it for this past week. That's amazing.

dialogue.origin: 立派だと思いますよ
dialogue.content: I think that's admirable.

dialogue.origin: 辛かった
dialogue.content: It was painful.

dialogue.origin: そうかな
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: 休み時間とかずっとトイレにいた
dialogue.content: During breaks, I was in the bathroom the whole time.

dialogue.origin: はい。すごく忍耐強くて立派だと思います
dialogue.content: Yes. I think you're very patient and admirable.

dialogue.origin: でももう頑張れそうにない
dialogue.content: But I don't think I can keep trying anymore.

dialogue.origin: 何もかも嫌だ
dialogue.content: I hate everything.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 勉強もしたくないし、頑張らなきゃって思うけど何もする気がしない
dialogue.content: I don't want to study, and even though I think I have to try, I have no motivation.

dialogue.origin: 何であたしばっかりこんなに辛いのかなって思う
dialogue.content: I keep thinking, why am I the only one who has to suffer this much?

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。辛い中頑張ってるよね。このことはうちの人に相談したかな？
dialogue.content: I understand. You're trying so hard while going through this pain. Have you talked to your family about this?

dialogue.origin: 話してない
dialogue.content: I haven't.

dialogue.origin: そうか、、一人で抱えて辛かったね
dialogue.content: I see... It must have been hard to bear this all by yourself.

dialogue.origin: お母さんに言ったって無駄じゃない？
dialogue.content: Wouldn’t it be pointless to tell my mom?

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。そう思っているのですね
dialogue.content: I see. That’s how you feel about it.

dialogue.origin: 言ったらお母さんになんて言われそう？
dialogue.content: What do you think your mom would say if you told her?

dialogue.origin: 別に何も、、、あんたが何かしたんじゃないの？とか
dialogue.content: Nothing much... "Didn't you do something to cause it?" or something like that.

dialogue.origin: 気にしてもしょうがないとか
dialogue.content: Or, 'There’s no point in worrying about it.'

dialogue.origin: お母さんはいつもそんな感じなのかな？
dialogue.content: Is your mom always like that?

dialogue.origin: そういつも怒られる
dialogue.content: Yes, I always get scolded.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。いつも怒られたら嫌な気持ちにまりますね
dialogue.content: I see. It must feel awful to always be scolded.

dialogue.origin: お母さんとはしゃべりたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to talk to my mom.

dialogue.origin: 何しても怒られるから
dialogue.content: Because no matter what I do, I get scolded.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか。他の家族はどうかな？
dialogue.content: I see, I see. What about other family members?

dialogue.origin: お父さん？お父さんになんて相談できないお父さんもどうせ「大したことじゃない」って言う
dialogue.content: My dad? I can't talk to my dad. He would just say, "It's not a big deal."

dialogue.origin: みんな絶対「お前に悪いとこがあるから無視されるんだ」って言うと思う
dialogue.content: I'm sure everyone would say, "You're being ignored because you did something wrong."

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。分かってもらえなくて寂しいね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be lonely not being understood.

dialogue.origin: そうなのかなもう何もかも嫌
dialogue.content: Maybe… I just hate everything now.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。辛い気持ちが伝わってくるよ。そんな中今日は相談に来てくれたんだね
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. I can feel how painful this is for you. And despite that, you still came here to talk today.

dialogue.origin: うん、、、
dialogue.content: Yeah...

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: すこしづつ考えようね。怒らせてしまった友達と何があったのか話せるかな…？
dialogue.content: Let’s think about it step by step. Would you be able to tell me what happened with the friend you angered?

dialogue.origin: 話せるところだけでもいいよ。
dialogue.content: You only have to share what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.origin: はいあたしがその子の文句言ってたっていうのが本人にばれて、、、すごいわがままで自己中な子でいつも振り回されててそれで、グチっちゃったんだけど
dialogue.content: Okay. She found out I was complaining about her... She's really selfish and self-centered, always pushing us around, so I just vented about it.

dialogue.origin: みんなもそう思ってるのに
dialogue.content: But everyone else feels the same way.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: みんなも言ってるのにあたしだけハブられてみんなあの子にいい顔しててそれもムカつくし
dialogue.content: Everyone else says it too, but I'm the only one being excluded. They're all being nice to her face, and that pisses me off too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。みんなもそう思っているのに、あなただけが無視されてしまうとすごく複雑だね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be very complicated to be the only one ignored when everyone else feels the same way.

dialogue.origin: そう謝るとなんか負けたみたいだし悪口言ってたの認めるみたいになるし
dialogue.content: Yeah. If I apologize, it feels like I'm admitting defeat and that I was badmouthing her.

dialogue.origin: そうだね。嫌な気持ちになるね…
dialogue.content: I understand. That would feel awful...

dialogue.origin: なんであたしだけ？みんないい顔してずるい
dialogue.content: Why only me? They're all being two-faced. It's not fair.

dialogue.origin: 嫌いなのに何で仲良くできるのかな
dialogue.content: How can they act friendly when they dislike her?

dialogue.origin: みんなずるい！と感じてるんだね…
dialogue.content: So you feel like everyone is being unfair...

dialogue.origin: あなたはすごく正直で間違ったことが嫌いなんだね。
dialogue.content: You seem very honest and you dislike things that feel wrong.

dialogue.origin: そうなのかなみんな何で平気なんですかね？みんな信じられないです
dialogue.content: I guess so. How can everyone else be okay with it? I can't trust anyone.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。そう感じるのも無理はないね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. It’s understandable that you feel that way.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら心ではみんな平気ではないのかも…
dialogue.content: Perhaps deep down, they aren't really okay with it either...

dialogue.origin: あなたはすごく勇気があるのだね。
dialogue.content: You have a lot of courage.

dialogue.origin: そうなのかな勇気なんてないですすぐに顔に出ちゃうあと考えすぎって言われる
dialogue.content: I don't know. I don't have any courage. My feelings show on my face right away, and people tell me I overthink things.

dialogue.origin: でも考えちゃうんだからしょうがないどうしたら考えるのやめられるの？本当は嫌いなのに表面だけ仲良くするのも嫌
dialogue.content: But I can't help but think about it. How can I stop thinking? I also hate pretending to be friends with someone I actually dislike.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: みんなに無視されている辛い状況だから、ずっと考えようしまうのは無理もないと思います。でも習慣すごく辛い状況のなかたえて偉かったね。
dialogue.content: Since you're in this painful situation of being ignored by everyone, I think it's natural that you keep thinking about it. But you've endured this incredibly difficult situation for a week, and that's really admirable.

dialogue.origin: 考えよう→考えて
dialogue.content: (Correction: The intended verb was "keep thinking," not "let's think")
Okay. (^^)

dialogue.origin: 偉くないけど
dialogue.content: I’m not admirable, though.

dialogue.origin: 偉くないしもう頑張れないし
dialogue.content: I’m not admirable, and I can’t keep trying anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 今回は陰で言っているのがばれてしまった形なのかな？
dialogue.content: So this time, it seems like what you were saying behind her back was discovered, is that right?

dialogue.origin: そう…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: もしかしたらその伝わり方が相手の事を余計におこらせてしまう事になってしまったのかな？と思ったのだけどそこらへんはどう感じてますか？
dialogue.content: I was wondering if perhaps the way the message was relayed to her ended up making her even angrier. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.origin: あたし顔に出ちゃうし態度にも出してたつもりだから気がついてなかったのかと思って
dialogue.content: Since it shows on my face and in my attitude, I was surprised she hadn't already noticed.

dialogue.origin: 陰で言ってたのは悪いと思うけど
dialogue.content: I know it was wrong to talk behind her back, though.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか
dialogue.content: I see, I see.

dialogue.origin: おなたがお言うようにあなたと同じ気持ちでいる周りの人たちは、今は様子を見てる感じかなと思うのだけどどうかな？
dialogue.content: As you mentioned, the other people who feel the same way as you... do you think they might just be watching to see what happens for now?

dialogue.origin: でもとても辛いよね…
dialogue.content: But it's still very painful for you...

dialogue.origin: みんなはあの子の味方なのかなあの子すごい強いから
dialogue.content: I wonder if everyone is on her side. She has a very strong personality.

dialogue.origin: あっちから悪口言ってきたりしたのに、なんであたしだけチクられて無視されなきゃなんだろう
dialogue.content: She's said bad things about me, too, so why am I the only one who gets tattled on and ignored?

dialogue.origin: でもみんなも言ってるとは言えないし
dialogue.content: But I can't tell her that everyone else talks about her too.

dialogue.origin: そうだね。理不尽だね。
dialogue.content: That's right. It's unfair.

dialogue.origin: だから謝りたくないあたしだけが悪いの？
dialogue.content: That’s why I don’t want to apologize. Am I the only one at fault?

dialogue.origin: そこを言わずに堪えているんだね
dialogue.content: And you're holding that in without saying it.

dialogue.origin: そう！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: あなたはすごく正直で強い人だと思います。
dialogue.content: I think you're a very honest and strong person.

dialogue.origin: そうかなぁ
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: みんなそんな強さがあったらいいのに　とおもっていると思うよ…
dialogue.content: I think everyone else wishes they had that kind of strength...

dialogue.origin: でももう頑張れないから強くないです
dialogue.content: But I can’t keep going anymore, so I’m not strong.

dialogue.origin: すごく今は、辛い状況だけど、一人でもわかってくれる人がでてくるといいね。
dialogue.content: It's a very painful situation right now, but it would be great if even one person came forward who understands.

dialogue.origin: はい、、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: みんな同じことを思っているのなら、いつかは正直に言っているあたなのほうに来てくれる人があると思います
dialogue.content: If everyone feels the same way, I believe someone will eventually come over to your side, since you're the one being honest.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談終了の時間がきてしまったのだけど、この相談の続きはまたいつでもしてくれたらと思います。少しづつでもいい方向に向かっていくことを願っています。
dialogue.content: Our time for today's session is up, but please feel free to continue this conversation anytime. I hope things will start moving in a better direction, even if it's little by little.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談に来てくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in to talk today.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. And thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: （これで終了させていただきます）
dialogue.content: (We will end the session now.)

dialogue.origin: （はいとても勉強になりました！ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.content: (Okay, this was very helpful! Thank you very much!)
